Test bitwise programs (rotations/shifts combined with AND/OR/XOR, or majority/choice, plus an optional constant XOR) against the examples (11011111->11110001; 00011010->10001111; 00110001->01100110). The one consistent with every example is: out = (rotl(x,3) XOR shl(x,4)) XOR 11111111. Apply it to x=00001110: rotl(x,3) = 01110000; shl(x,4) = 11100000; rotl(x,3) XOR shl(x,4) = 10010000; XOR constant 11111111 -> 01101111. So the output is 01101111.

Answer: 01101111
